results.content:
The visitor programme hosted three university groups and one film crew this quarter. Overtime hours fell compared with last quarter after the new rota was introduced. Quarterly spending stayed within budget, with fuel the largest single line at forty-one percent. A review of the incident found that the storm warning reached the station but was not posted on the board. The storm on the night of the fourteenth tore two panels from the solar array and flooded the boat shed.

The spare impeller for the intake pump is stocked as part KX4471 in the north store; order a replacement as soon as the spare is fitted.
